s: Debarim hammuttarim vehaasurim letaltel beshabbat ubo p"t seipim: aseru chakamim letaltel miqtzat debarim beshabbat kederek shehu oseh bechol. Umippene ma nageu beissur zeh? Ameru: ma im hizhiru nebiim vetzivvu shello yehe hillukeka beshabbat kehillukeka bechol, velo sichat hashshabbat kesichat hachol, shenneemar "vedabber dabar" — qal vachomer shello yehe hattiltul beshabbat ketiltul bechol, kede shello yehe keyom chol beenayv veyabo lehagbiah uletaqqen kelim mippinna lepinna o mibbayit lebayit, o lehatznia lehassia abanim vekayyotze bahen, shehare hu batel veyosheb bebeto vibaqqesh dabar sheyyitasseq bo, venimtza shello shabat, ubatel hattaam shenneemar battora "lemaan yanuach". Veod, mippene geder hotzaa nageu bah, shemma yishkach veyotzi haddabar shemmetaltel beyado lirshut harabbim. Vehaya min harauy lepi zeh leesor apillu tiltul kelim shetztzarik lahem, ella sheen gozerim al hatztzibbur yoter midday. Veod, mippene shemmiqtzat haam enam baale umanut ella betelim kol yemehem, kegon hattayyalin veyoshebe qeranot shekkol yemehem hem shobetim mimmelaka, veim yihyeh muttar lehallek uledabber uletaltel kishar hayyamim — nimtza shello shabat shebita hannikkeret, lepikak shebita middebarim ellu hi shebita hashshava bekol adam. Umippene zeh nageu beissur hattiltul, veaseru shello yetaltel adam beshabbat ella kelim shetztzarik lahem, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Kol dabar sheyyesh torat keli alayv — muttar letaltelo beshabbat, al derek sheyyitbaer, apillu keli shemmelakto leissur, dehaynu shehakkeli hu meyuchad lehishtammesh bo tashmish haasur beshabbat, kegon qurdom shemmebaqqeim bo etzim, o qurnos shel nappachim o shel zehabim vekayyotze bahem. Vaapillu keli shemmelakto leissur shehu muqtzeh mechamat miuso, dehaynu sheadam massiach umaqtzeh dato mimmennu mechamat miuso millehishtammesh bo bimlaka acheret shel hetter, kegon ner yashan shel cheres shello hidliqu bo beotah shabbat — en lo din muqtzeh bishbil kak. Vaapillu im eno rauy kelal lehishtammesh bo bimlaka acheret shel hetter mechamat miuso vesirchono, kegon ner, apillu shel matteket, shehidliqu bo nept — ap al pi ken en lo din muqtzeh leheaser betiltul, ella muttar letaltelo kishar keli shemmelakto leissur, mippene shemmikkol maqom rauy hu lekassot bo kelim:

Vaapillu keli shehiqtza oto millehishtammesh bo shum tashmish, kegon kelim hammukanim veomedim lischora, sheen regilim lehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish, mikkol maqom im eno maqpid alehem millehishtammesh bahem — lo hissiach dato adayin mehem legamre millehishtammesh bahem, ulepikak en lahem din muqtzeh leheaser betiltul. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar shehu keli mammash abal dabar sheeno keli mammash, ella sheyyesh alayv torat keli mechamat sherauy lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish beshabbat, kegon gizzin shel tzemer sheruyin lehissamek velashebet alehem, veken kol kayyotze bahem, im hiknisan laotzar lischora — bittel torat keli shehaya alehem, veasur letaltelam, ap al pi sheeno maqpid kelal alehem millehishtammesh bahem, ella im ken chazar veyichado letashmish leolam:

Vekol hakkelim shehem omedim lischora vehu maqpid alehem shello lehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish, ap al pi sheenam kelim hayqarim beyoter, veen tzarik lomar kelim hayqarim beyoter ap al pi sheenan lischora, ella shemmelaktam leissur, umaqpid alehem millehishtammesh bahem tashmish acher shello yippachatu demehem — asur letaltelo beshabbat apillu letzorek meqomo, dehaynu shetztzarik lehishtammesh ezeh tashmish bimqom shekkeli zeh munnach sham, o letzorek gupo, dehaynu shennimlak lehishtammesh ezeh tashmish begup keli zeh. (Vehu shennimlak ken mishshechasheka, abal im nimlak ken mibbeod yom — muttar letaltelo, shemmachashaba moelet lemuqtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer). Vezehu hanniqra muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis:

Veken sakkin shel shechita veshel mila, veizmel shel separim, vesakkin shel soperim shemmetaqqenin bo haqqulmosim, kevan shemmaqpidim shello lehishtammesh bahem tashmish acher hammuttar beshabbat — asur letaltelam apillu letzorek gupam umeqomam. Vaapillu im hassakkin hazzeh tachub bindan im sakkinim acherim — en omerim shemmin hassetam en maqpid alayv kelal, hoil utechabo bindan im shear sakkinim. Umikkol maqom, en issur ella lehotzi sakkin zeh mehannedan, o letaltel hannedan im sakkin zeh leachar shehotzi mittoko shear hassakkinim, abal beod sheshshear hassakkinim betoko — muttar letaltelo, ap al pi shessakkin zeh gam ken betoko. Vehu shei epshar lenaer sakkin zeh mehannedan, o sheyyesh chashash hepsed im yenaarennu, o shetztzarik limqom hannedan, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"t vesh"y bishar keli shehu basis leissur ulehetter, ayyen sham hattaam lekol zeh:

Veken qurnas sheddakin bo besamim bimqomot shemmaqpidim alayv shello lehishtammesh bo tashmish acher shello yitlaklek — hare zeh muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis. Abal bimqomot sheen maqpidim alayv — muttar letaltelo letzorek gupo o meqomo kishar keli shemmelakto leissur, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veken neyar chalaq haomed liktiba — hu muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis, shemmaqpid alayv shello lehishtammesh alayv shum tashmish shello yitlaklek. Veod, shekkevan shemmaqpid alayv shello lehishtammesh bo — en alayv torat keli kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Nimtzeta lamed sheshshelosha mine muqtzeh hem bekelim, shenayim muttarim betiltul, vehashshelishi asur. Muqtzeh mechamat mius umuqtzeh mechamat shehiqtza oto millehishtammesh — muttarim, umuqtzeh mechamat chesron kis — asur. Veyesh od min muqtzeh rebii, vehu dabar shehaya muqtzeh mechamat issur beben hashshemashot vehalak lo haissur beshabbat, veyesh bedabar zeh lehaqel ulehachamir, veyitbaer zeh besimman sh"y:

Vekol zeh bedabar sheyyesh torat keli alayv, abal kol dabar sheen torat keli alayv veeno maakal adam velo maakal behema, kegon abanim, umaot, veetzim, veqanim, veqorot, veapar, vechol, veqemach, veissa (shel yisrael, abal shel nokri yesh mattirim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y), vehammet, ubaale chayyim, vekol kayyotze bidbarim ellu, vaapillu dabar shehu rauy lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish hammuttar beshabbat, kegon abanim sheruyin liptzoa bahen egozim, utzerorot sheruyot lekassot bahen kelim, vekol kayyotze bahem, kevan sheen torat keli alehem — asur letaltelam apillu letzorek gupam umeqomam, ella al pi hadderakim sheyyitbaaru. Vezehu hanniqra muqtzeh mechamat gupo:

Ubiklal muqtzeh zeh hu, kol maakalot haasurot bahanaa, sheeno yakol lehaakilan apillu lakkelabim, vaapillu en issuran ella middibre soperim, kegon setam yenam vekayyotze bo, vaapillu en issuran ella bo bayyom bilbad, kegon tebel sheyyakol letaqqeno bemotzae shabbat uleoklo, ella shebbeshabbat asur letaqqeno middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"t, veken kol kayyotze bazeh — hu muqtzeh mechamat gupo, veasur letaltelo apillu letzorek gupo umeqomo. Abal maakalot haasurot baakila umuttarot bahanaa, sheyyakol lehaakilan lakkelabim im hen mukanin veomedim lehaakilan lakkelabim, kegon nebelot uterepot vekayyotze bahen — muttar letaltelan kishar maakale behema. Veim enan omedim lakkelabim mechamat issuran, mippene sheen issuran ella beshabbat, kegon mashqin shezzabu min happerot mealehen beshabbat, sheasurim bishtiyya bo bayyom bilbad, veken betza shennoleda beshabbat, sheasura baakila bo bayyom bilbad, veken chalab shennechlab beshabbat, sheasur bo bayyom bilbad, veken kol kayyotze bahem, ap al pi sheyyakol lehaakilam lakkelabim, mikkol maqom kevan sheenan omedim lekak ella laakilat adam bemotzae shabbat — asur letaltelan apillu letzorek gupan umeqoman. Abal dabar sheissur akilato hu gam bechol, ap al pi sheyyesh lo hetter leachar zeman, kegon hechadash — muttar letaltelo apillu beeretz yisrael, shekkevan shennimshak zeman issuro harbeh — hare hu omed gam betok hazzeman lehaakilo libhemot ulemokro lenokrim:

Veyesh od min muqtzeh beokalim umashqim beshabbat veyom tob, vehu muqtzeh mechamat mitzva, sheyyitbaer besimman trl"ch vetaqay"d. Nimtzeu kol mine hammuqtzeh haasurim chamishsha, muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis, umuqtzeh mechamat gupo, umuqtzeh mechamat issur hanaa o akila, umuqtzeh mechamat mitzva, umuqtzeh mechamat shehaya asur beben hashshemashot sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y:

Kol dabar sheyyesh alayv torat keli, apillu im hu gadol vekabed harbeh — lo nitbattel shem keli mimmennu lo mechamat godlo velo mechamat kobdo. Vehu haddin leeben gedola o qora gedola, apillu mittaltelet baasara bene adam, im yesh torat keli aleha, kegon sheyyichada letaltelah leezeh tashmish veal derek sheyyitbaer — muttar letaltelah beshabbat:

Keli shemmelakto leissur — muttar letaltelo ben letzorek gupo, kegon qurdom lachtok bo debela, vequrnas liptzoa bo egozim, o apillu lismok bo kelim vekayyotze bazeh, ben letzorek meqomo. Abal letzorek hakkeli atzmo, kegon shehakkeli munnach bemaqom sheyyare shello yigganeb mishsham, o shello yippol veyishshaber, o shemmunnach bechamma veyare shello yitbaqqea sham verotzeh letaltelo mishsham limqom hatztzel, vekol kayyotze bazeh — asur. Veim mechashsheb alayv lehishtammesh bo tashmish bemaqom acher, o shemmechashsheb lehishtammesh ezeh tashmish bemaqom zeh shehakkeli munnach sham — muttar lo letaltelo mimmaqom zeh, ap al pi sheiqqar kavvanato betiltulo hu kede shello yigganeb o yishshaber bemaqom zeh:

Keshemmetaltelo letzorek meqomo — eno tzarik lehashliko miyyado miyyad sheppinnuhu mimmaqom zeh hatztzarik lo, ella muttar lehannicho beezeh maqom sheyyirtzeh lehatznio sham, shekkevan shekkebar hu beyado — rashshay letaltelo yoter mimmah shetztzarik lo. Vaapillu im shakach venatal beyado muqtzeh gamur — rashshay letaltelo lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kevan shekkebar hu beyado. Veyesh mi sheoser bemuqtzeh gamur. Verauy lachush lidbarayv, ella im ken bimqom hepsed, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"v:

Kol muqtzeh eno asur ella betiltul, abal muttar ligga bo beyadayv, ubilbad shello yenaanea apillu miqtzato, ukemo shennitbaer besimman rs"h. Velaken muttar ligga bimnora shehannerot doleqot aleha im enah teluya baavir, kemo shennitbaer sham, o betannur bet hachorep shehaesh doleqet betoko. Veken muttar liqqach debar hetter hammunnach al debar muqtzeh, kemo shennitbaer sham, veken lehannicho al gabbayv. Veken muttar lesheb alayv ap im hu mitnaanea tachtayv, shettiltul kilachar yad hu, ubilbad shello yigga bo beyadayv, kemo sheyyitbaer, mippene shekkol muqtzeh eno asur bahanaa lehishtammesh bo belo tiltul. Ubilbad shello yaaseh maaseh begup hammuqtzeh al yede tashmish zeh, kegon lehatztzit esh beyom tob tachat atze muqtzeh ap al pi sheeno mezizem kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"a:

Kol muqtzeh eno asur ella letaltelo kedarko bechol, dehaynu beyadayv, abal muttar letaltelo begupo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a, vezehu niqra tiltul kilachar yad, shehu beshinnuy midderek hachol. Velaken muttar letaltel muqtzeh beraglayv, lepannoto lekan ulekan derek hilluko, letzorek meqomo, o apillu letzorek hammuqtzeh atzmo kede lehatznio (ayyen simman shy"a). Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar letaltel muqtzeh al yede nippuach, sheen leka tiltul kilachar yad gadol mizzeh:

Keli shemmelakto lehetter, dehaynu shehu meyuchad letashmish hammuttar beshabbat, kegon kos uqeara vekayyotze bahen — muttar letaltelo apillu shello letzorek gupo umeqomo ella letzorek hakkeli atzmo, shechoshesh alayv shello yishshaber o shello yigganeb mishsham umetaltelo mishsham lehatznio, o shemmetaltelo mechamma letzel shechoshesh shello yitbaqqea bechamma. Abal shello letzorek kelal — asur letaltel shum keli ap al pi shemmelakto lehetter, lepi shebbime nechemya ben chakalya shehayu haam mezalzelim beissure shabbat, kemo shekkatub "bayyamim hahem raiti bihuda doreki[m] gittot bashshabbat umebiim haaremot vego'", asu chakamim seyag vegader leissur hotzaa, vegazeru al kol hakkelim ap al pi shemmelaktam lehetter shello letaltelam kelal apillu letzorek tashmishan hammeyuchad lahem, chutz min kosot uqearot vesakkin vekayyotze bahem mehakkelim hatztzerikim beyoter lisuddat hashshabbat. Veachar kak kesherau chakamim shechazeru haam lehizzaher qetzat beissure shabbat — chazeru vehittiru letaltel kol keli shemmelakto lehetter letzorek gupo o letzorek meqomo. Veachar kak kesherau shechazeru haam lehizzaher yoter — chazeru vehittiru letaltel kol keli shemmelakto lehetter apillu letzorek hakkeli atzmo, abal letaltel shello letzorek kelal adayin lo nimnu alayv chakamim lehattiro, venishar omed beissuro shenneesar bigzerat chakamim shebbime nechemya ben chakalya:

Abal kol mine okalim umashqim hammuttarim beshabbat, vekol mine separim shemmuttar liqrot bahem — muttar letaltelam apillu shello letzorek kelal, lepi shello gazeru bime nechemya ella al kelim velo al okalim useparim, vahare hem akshav kemo qodem haggezera shebbime nechemya, shehaya muttar letaltel kol dabar harauy beshabbat apillu shello letzorek kelal. Abal dabar sheeno rauy beshabbat — haya asur letaltel ap bime david ushelomoh o qodem leken. Mah sheen ken kelim, apillu kosot uqearot vesakkin vekayyotze bahen -kullan hayu biklal haggezera, sheggazeru gam alehen shello letaltelan ki im letzorek tashmishan, velo letzorek meqoman velo letzorek gupan kesheeno tashmish hammeyuchad lahen, shehare lo hotziu otan mikkelal shear kelim ella mippene hatztzorek sheyyesh betashmishan yoter mibbetashmish shear kol hakkelim, im ken en lehattiran ella letzorek tashmishan bilbad. Veachar kak keshehittiru, vechazeru vehittiru, letaltel kol keli shemmelakto lehetter apillu letzorek hakkeli atzmo, gam kosot uqearot vesakkin vekayyotze bahen hayu biklal zeh, velo hutteru ella letaltelan letzorek hakkeli atzmo, abal lo shello letzorek kelal:

Umikkol maqom, muttar leadam lissa hassakkin etzlo ap kesheholek lebet hakkeneset bemaqom sheyyesh sham erub, ap al pi sheeno tzarik sham lesakkin, kevan sheyyitztarek lo achar kak bo bayyom, velo aseru tiltul shello letzorek ella kesheeno tzarik lo kelal kol hayyom, abal im yishtammesh bo hayyom vehu noseo etzlo kede sheyyihyeh mukan lo bishato — muttar, kevan shehu chapetz bekak sheyyihyeh mukan lo — hare zeh tiltul letzorek:

Hattepillin en dinan kesipre haqqodesh, velo apillu kikli shemmelakto lehetter, shehare asur latzet bahen lirshut harabbim, vekol dabar sheasur latzet bo — asur lelobsho kelal beshabbat apillu betok habbayit, shemma yishkach veyetze bo, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"g. Veap lehammattirin sham lilbosh babbayit — en hattepillin keli shemmelakto lehetter, hoil vehen meyuchadim lelobshan leshem mitzva, ubeshabbat asur lelobshan leshem mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman l"a, lepikak asur letaltelan apillu letzorek atzman, kegon lehatznian shello yigganebu im hu maqom sherob haggannabim hammetzuyim sham hem yisreelim, shello yabou hattepillin lide bizzayon beyadam. Abal letzorek gupan, kegon bishbil sheyyishmeruhu min hammazziqin, o letzorek meqoman — muttar letaltelan kedin keli shemmelakto leissur, shemmikkol maqom yesh alehen torat keli umalbush, shehare hayyotze bahen lirshut harabbim — patur, hoil vehen derek malbush vetakshit, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a:

Veken hashshopar o chatzotzerot ushear kele shir — asur letaltelam ki im letzorek gupam o meqomam kedin keli shemmelakto leissur, sheasur litqoa o lezammer bikle shir beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqp"ch veshal"t:
Keli shemmelakto leissur ulehetter — muttar letaltelo ap letzorek hakkeli atzmo kedin keli shemmelakto lehetter, hoil vehu meyuchad gam ken limleket hetter:

Medoka, im yesh bah shum vekayyotze bo middebarim hanniddokim bah — muttar letaltelah ap letzorek atzmah, ap al pi shehu keli shemmelakto leissur, lepi shehammedoka hi tepela ubetela lehashshum shebbetokah kemo shehaqqedera tepela lehattabshil shebbetokah, vahare zeh keillu metaltel et hashshum bilbaddo, shemmuttar letaltelo ap shello letzorek kelal. Abal im natan bammedoka kikkar o tinoq, o shear debarim hammuttarim betiltul sheen hammedoka tepela lahem — asur letaltelah al yede ken letzorek atzmah, shebbemet bilbad hu shehittiru letaltel mechamma letzel al yede kikkar o tinoq vekayyotze bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a. Veyesh choleqim veomerim shehammedoka o shear kol keli shemmelakto leissur muttar letaltelo letzorek hakkeli atzmo al yede kikkar o tinoq o shear dabar hammuttar betiltul, velo ameru shello hittiru betiltul al yede kikkar o tinoq lebad min hammet, ella betiltul muqtzeh gamur haasur letaltelo ap letzorek gupo umeqomo, abal keli shemmelakto leissur sheeno muqtzeh gamur veheqellu bo letaltelo letzorek gupo o meqomo — heqellu bo gam ken letaltelo al yede kikkar o tinoq ap letzorek hakkeli atzmo. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bimqom hepsed merubbeh yesh lismok al sebara haacharona:

Hannolad muttar beshabbat, kegon nokri sheasa keli chadash beshabbat meatzmo — muttar letaltelo ulehishtammesh bo, al derek shennitbaer besimman rn"b vesimman sh"y, ap al pi shello haya dato alayv meetmol letaltelo lemachar. Abal beyom tob yesh lehachamir benolad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"h:

Veken kol hakkelim hammuttarim betiltul shennishberu beshabbat veen hashshebarim reuyim lehishtammesh bahem meen melaktam harishona ella meen melaka acheret legamre, kegon shibre areba lekassot bahem pi chabit, veshibre keli zekukit lekassot bahem pi happak, veken kol kayyotze bazeh — hare zeh nolad shennaasa keli chadash, umuttar beshabbat velo beyom tob, ella im ken nishberu meereb yom tob, shez hukenu limlaka acheret mibbeod yom, veen zeh nolad:

Abal im hashshebarim reuyim lehishtammesh bahem meen melaktam harishona, kegon shibre areba latzuq letokan miqpa aba, shehi domeh leissa hamorebet bemayim shemmishtammeshim baareba, veshibre keli zekukit latzuq letokam shemen — en zeh nolad, umuttar letaltelam ap im nishberu beyom tob:

Veim en hashshebarim reuyim leshum melaka — hare hem muqtzeh gamur, lepi sheen torat keli alehem kelal, veasur letaltelam beshabbat, ben shennishberu beshabbat ben shennishberu bechol. Abal beyom tob im nishberu mibbeod yom — muttar letaltelam lehassaqa im hem reuyim lekak, kemo shemmuttar letaltel beyom tob shear etzim haomedim lehesseq ap sheen torat keli alehem:

Vekol zeh bekelim hammuttarim betiltul shennishberu, abal kelim hammuqtzim mechamat chesron kis shennishberu, ap al pi shehashshebarim enam muqtzim mechamat chesron kis, im nishberu beshabbat o beyom tob — asur letaltelam bo bayyom, shemmittok shehuqtzu middaat haadam beben hashshemashot keshehaya hakkeli hammuqtzeh shalem adayin — huqtzu lekol hayyom kullo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y:

Kol hashshebarim haasurim betiltul, apillu otan sheenam reuyim leshum melaka, im hem munnachim bemaqom sheyyekolim lehazziq, kegon kele zekukit shennishberu al hashshulchan o bemaqom sheholekin — muttar letaltel hashshebarim kede lepannotam shello yizzoqu bahem rabbim, shebbimqom hezzeq haggup shel rabbim lo gazeru al issur muqtzeh, vaapillu al issur tiltul bekarmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal shibre keli cheres haasurim betiltul — asur lepannotam. Veap sheddoresim alehem venishbarim — en bekak kelum, sheen issur bishbirat cheres, ella im ken shobero bemitkavven bishbil sheyyehe rauy al yede kak leezeh tashmish, sheaz asur mishshum tiqqun keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y:

Chatikat cheres shennishbera mikkeli ben bechol ben beshabbat vehi reuya lekassot bah keli — muttar letaltelah, vaapillu bemaqom sheen kelim metzuyim sham lekassotam bah, kegon shemmunnachat birshut harabbim — muttar letaltelah sham pachot mid' ammot, hoil veyesh torat keli aleha bechatzer sheyyesh sham kelim. Veken haddin beshibre shear kelim. Ella sheshshear kelim yesh mehen sheen shibrehem muttarim betiltul ella im ken hem gedolim qetzat, kegon shibre areba lekassot bahem pi chabit, abal im enam reuyim lekissuy pi chabit, ap al pi sheruyim lekissuy pi keli qatan mechabit — en torat keli alehem kelal, lepi sheshshebarim haqqetannim shel haarebah derek lezorqam laashpa, veen derek kelal leyachadam lekissuy pi keli qatan mechabit. Abal chatikat cheres, apillu hi qetanna, derek hu lipamim leyachadah lekissuy pi keli qatan, lepikak yesh torat keli aleha ap al pi shello yichadah adayin:

Veim nishbera mehakkeli bechol uzeraqah leashpa mibbeod yom — asur letaltelah beshabbat, kevan shehiqtza otah millekassot bah kelim, ubittelah mihyot od torat keli aleha. Vaapillu im hi reuya laaniyyim lekissuy kelim, ella shebbealeha hu ashir uzeraqah laashpa — ap al pi ken asura betiltul lekol haaniyyim shebbaolam, shehakkol holek achar habbealim, kemo sheyyitbaer:
Abal im zeraqah laashpa beshabbat — muttar letaltelah, hoil vehaya aleha torat keli beben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat:

Lo bekol dabar ameru sheim rauy lekassot bo keli yesh torat keli alayv ella beshibre kelim bilbad, hoil vehaya kebar alehem torat keli gamur keshehayu shelemim, laken lo nipqa mehem ap keshennishberu im reuyin adayin lekissuy. Abal kol dabar sheen bo shayyakut keli gamur, kegon tzerorot o abanim vekayyotze bahem, ap al pi sheruyim lekassot bahem kelim — lo yarad alehem torat keli bishbil kak, veasur letaltelam apillu letzorek gupam umeqomam, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Velaken tzarik lehazhir larabbim shennikshalim venotelim chatikat etz sheenah keli lismok bah ezeh dap lishkob alayv, vekayyotze beinyan zeh. Abal al yede nokri muttar kol tiltul muqtzeh kesheeno letzorek hammuqtzeh atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v:

Shibre petila sheenan omedim od lehadlaqa bener — hare hen kitzrorot vaabanim sheasur letaltelan apillu letzorek gupan umeqoman. Abal petila shelema, apillu nidleqa kebar bechol o beshabbat sheobra — hi niqret keli, vedinah kikli shemmelakto leissur shemmuttar letaltelo letzorek gupo umeqomo. Abal im dolqa beben hashshemashot shel shabbat zo — huqtzet lekol hayyom kullo, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"t. Veken ner shalem shel shaava o shel cheleb, vaapillu nidlaq kebar bechol o beshabbat sheobra — niqra keli shemmelakto leissur. Umikkan yatza taut hehamon shemmetaltelim ner shalem letzorek hadlaqat motzae shabbat, o letzorek nokri sheyyadliqenna leatzmo, vetoim hem, sheeno muttar letaltel keli shemmelakto leissur ella keshetztzarik yisrael lehishtammesh bo beshabbat atzmah ezeh tashmish hammuttar beshabbat, kegon qurnas liptzoa bo egozim, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Kol hakkelim sheyyesh lahem delatot qebuot bahem, ben shehaddelet hu min hatztzad ben shehu kissuy al gabbe hakkeli, venitparequ haddelatot mehem, ben shennitparequ beshabbat ben shennitparequ qodem hashshabbat — muttar letaltel otan haddelatot, mippene shekkeshehayu haddelatot mechubbarot bakkelim haya gam alehen shem keli aggab abihen, veap shennitparequ achar kak mehakkelim — lo nipqa mehem shem keli shehaya alehen, hoil ureuyot lehachaziran ulechabberan el hakkelim:

Abal daltot habbayit shennitparequ min habbayit, ben shennitparequ beshabbat ben shennitparequ qodem hashshabbat — asur letaltelan, mippene shello haya shem keli alehen meolam. Veap al pi sheakshav keshennitparequ hen reuyot lehishtammesh bahen kemo bishar nesarim — ap al pi ken enan muttarot betiltul, lepi shehen reuyot lehachaziran labbayit ulekak hen omedot, velo lehishtammesh alehen kishar nesarim. Delet shidda teba umigdal, im muttar littelah mehem o lehachazirah lahem — yitbaer besimman shy"g veshay"d:

Dabar sheen torat keli alayv sheasao kissuy likli — naasa alayv torat keli al yede kak, umuttar letaltelo kishar kelim. Vehu shettiqqeno veasa bo maaseh vehekino lekak beinyan shettiqquno mokiach alayv shehu omed lekak, veap al pi sheadayin lo nishtammesh bo lekissuy leolam. Veim nishtammesh bo lekissuy mibbeod yom apillu paam achat — zehu torat keli shello, umuttar letaltelo beshabbat ap al pi shello asa shum maaseh shel tiqqun. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar sheddarko laasoto lekissuy, kegon chatikot nesarim vekayyotze bahen, abal dabar sheen darko laasoto kissuy, ap al pi shennishtammesh bedabar zeh lekissuy peamim rabbot bechol, kegon eben shekkissa bah et pi hechabit peamim rabbot — asur letaltelah beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vekol zeh bekissuy kelim, abal kissuye haqqarqaot, kegon kissuy bor o dut, ap al pi shettiqqeno veasa bo maaseh, vegam nishtammesh bo peamim rabbot bechol — asur letaltelo, ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza sheochazin bo keshemmesirim oto mehabbor, shezzeh mokiach alayv shehu asuy lehittaltel veyesh alayv shem keli. Vekissuye kelim haqqeburim baqqarqa legamre — dinam kekissuye haqqarqaot, sheggazeru al ellu mippene ellu. Abal keli sheeno qabur baqqarqa legamre, ap al pi shehu mechubbar laqqarqa, kegon tannurim shebbimehem shehayu kiqdera umechubbarim lematta betit — en kissuyam tzarik bet achiza. Abal tannurim shellanu habbenuyim al gabbe qarqa — din kissuyam kekissuy haddut shetztzarik bet achiza:

Machat shelema — muttar letaltelah littol bah et haqqotz, kedin keli shemmelakto leissur shemmuttar letaltelo letzorek gupo. Ubilbad sheyyizzaher bintilat haqqotz sheyyittelennu shello yotzi dam bevadday al yede netilato, sheyyesh bezeh mishshum chobel ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak, kevan shennotelo beinyan shehu "pesiq resheh velo yamut", kegon im nithappek haqqotz bintilato vei epshar lehotzio mishsham mibbeli hotzaat dam — asur lehotzio:

Abal machat shennittal chuddah o chor shellah — asur letaltelah, mippene shebbatel torat keli mimmenna. Veenah doma leshibre shear kelim shemmuttarim betiltul hoil ureuyim letashmish acher, umachat zo shennittal chuddah o chorah reuya gam ken letashmish acher, kegon littol bah et haqqotz, mikkol maqom en regilut kelal leyached otah letashmish, ella darko shel adam lezorqah ben gerutaot (perush shibre mattekot), mah sheen ken beshibre shear kelim shergilim leyachadam letashmish acher, laken lo nipqa shem keli mehem. Umikkol maqom, im yiched machat zo leezeh tashmish — naasa aleha torat keli, umuttar letaltelah kedin keli shemmelakto lehetter im yichadah letashmish hammuttar beshabbat. Umachat chadasha shello niqqeba adayin — muttar letaltelah letzorek gupah, lepi shellipamim adam nimlak aleha umannichah kak belo neqeb umeyachadah lintilat qotz, laken yesh torat keli aleha ap sheadayin lo yichadah, mah sheen ken keshennittal chuddah adam zoreqah leben haggerutaot:

Sheyare machtzelaot shebbalu, ap al pi sheenan reuyot lesheb alehen — muttar letaltelan, shello nipqa mehem shem keli shehaya alehen, hoil vehen reuyot adayin lekassot bahen ezeh tinnup. Veim zeraqan laashpa mibbeod yom — asur letaltelan, kemo shennitbaer lemala beshibre shear kelim:

Abal matlaniyyot, shehen sheyare begadim shebbalu, im en bekol achat mehen g' al g' etzbaot — asur letaltelan, mippene sheenan reuyot lo laaniyyim velo laashirim. Veim yesh bahen g' al g' vehen shel ani — muttarim kol haaniyyim shebbaolam letaltelan, shehen reuyot lahem litlay bebigdehem, ella im ken zeraqum habbealim laashpa mibbeod yom. Abal ashirim asurim letaltelan ap al pi shehen shel ani, ella im ken yesh bahen g' tepachim al g' tepachim, sheaz hen reuyot gam laashirim. Veashir shehu dar bebeto shel ani zeh shehammatlaniyyot shello — hare hu nigrar achar baal habbayit, umuttar letaltelan ap al pi sheenam reuyot lo, hoil vehen reuyot bebayit zeh shehu dar bo. Abal matlaniyyot shel ashirim shehen pachot mig' tepachim al g' tepachim — asurot ap lekol haaniyyim shebbaolam, shekkevan shehuqtzu lebaalehen haashirim mippene sheenan reuyot lahem — huqtzu lekol haolam, mippene shennaasu keillu zarequ otan baalehen laashpa. Veken haddin bekol kayyotze bazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh omerim shemmatlaniyyot shehen sheyare setam begadim, ap al pi sheen bahem g' al g' etzbaot — muttarot betiltul lekol adam, hoil vehen reuyot leqanneach bahem ezeh tinnup. Velo chillequ ben g' al g' etzbaot lepachot mikken ella bematlaniyyot shehen sheyare tallitot shel mitzva, sheadam bodel atzmo milleqanneach bahen umillehishtammesh bahen tashmish megunneh. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona, sheap shehen reuyot leqinnuach — en torat keli alehen bishbil kak, ella im ken yichadan lekak, sheap shibre shear kol hakkelim en torat keli alehem ap im hem reuyim leqinnuach im lo yichadam lekak, o sheruyim lismok bahem ezeh keli velo yichadam lekak, ella im ken reuyim lekissuy keli, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Minal, ben chadash ben yashan, shehu mehuddaq al haddepus — muttar leshomto mimmennu, ben lishmot et haddepus mittok hamminal, ben lishmot hamminal meal haddepus. Veen kan issur betiltul haddepus, mippene shehaddepus yesh alayv shem keli ella shemmelakto leissur, umuttar letaltelo letzorek meqomo, dehaynu chalalo shel hamminal shehaddepus betoko:

Sandalim shebbimehem hayu lahem shette retzuot qebuot bishne tzedadehem, achat betzad penimi leben shene raglayim, veachat letzad chutz, vekorekim shette haretzuot al haregel lemala lehachaziq shene tzidde hassandal al raglo, mippene shello haya or besandalehem ella bitzdade hassandal bilbad, abal milmala haya patuach legamre, lepikak hayu tzerikim shette retzuot lehachaziq shene tzidde hassandal al raglo, veim nipseqa achat mehen i epshar lelek bo ad sheyyetaqqenennu, veap al pi ken muttar letaltelo ap im nipseqa im meqom qebiutah, mippene sheadayin yesh torat keli alayv, hoil vehu rauy lachazor uletaqqeno. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennipseqa happenimit shel ben haraglayim, sheim yetaqqenuha — en tiqqunah nireh. Abal im nipseqa hachitzona — en darkah letaqqenah, mippene shettiqqunah nireh lakkol ugenay hu, ulepikak batel hassandal mittorat keli veasur letaltelo. Veeno domeh leshibre shear kelim shemmuttarim betiltul hoil vehem reuyim lekissuy kelim, abal hassandal en darko lekassot bo kelim mippene meisuto:

Veim nipseqa keshehu mehallek bekarmelit — hittiru lo littol gemi lach shehu maakal behema umuttar betiltul velikrok oto al hassandal, veliqshor letaqqeno shello yippol meraglo. Abal asur liqshor alayv chut o meshicha, shemma yebattelem lihyot qebuim sham leolam, venimtza asa qesher shel qayyama. Veap begemi lach lo hittiru ken ella bekarmelit, sheim lo yaaseh ken veyaazob hassandal sham — yigganeb mishsham. Abal bechatzer shehu nishmar sham — asur liqshor begemi, shemma yimmalek vibattelennu, ben shennipseqa retzua happenimit ben hachitzona, ella sheim nipseqa penimit — rashshay letaltelo lehatznio bemaqom mutzna beoto chatzer, veim nipseqa chitzona — asur, kemo shennitbaer:
Vekol zeh besandalim shellahem, shemmishshennipseqa haretzua i epshar lenoolo kelal, abal sandalim shellanu ap im nipseqa haretzua rauy lenoolo vetorat keli alayv, umuttar letaltelo bekol inyan:

Chaluq shekkibbesu oto vetachabu bo qaneh meereb shabbat litloto bo leyabbesho — yakol leshomto min haqqaneh. Abal littol haqqaneh mittoko — asur, lepi sheeno keli, ella im ken yiched haqqaneh lekak, sheaz naasa alayv torat keli al yede yichud zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim tachabu bo keli-muttar littelo mittoko, apillu hu keli shemmelakto leissur, kevan shettiltul zeh hu letzorek meqomo, dehaynu chalal hechaluq shehaqqaneh betoko:

Kira shennishmeta achat miyyarkoteha, dehaynu pitputin shellah keen raglayim — asur letaltelah letzorek gupah, gezera shemma yachazir lah haregel veyitqaenna sham bechozeq, veyitchayyeb mishshum boneh. Veken sapsal arok shennishmeta achat meraglayv, kol shekken shettayim — asur letaltelo ulehannicho al sapsal acher velesheb alayv, apillu nishmeta haregel mibbeod yom, ella im ken yashab alayv kak paam achat qodem hashshabbat beli hachazarat haregel, sheaz en lachush shemma yimmalek lehachazirah uletoqah beshabbat. Abal asur lehachazirah lesham beshabbat apillu beripyon, gezera shemma yitqaenna bechozeq, ella im ken darkah leolam lihyot sham repuya, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"g. Vekol zeh keshennishmeta haregel, abal im nishbera — muttar letaltel hassapsal ulehannicho al sapsal acher velesheb alayv, apillu lo yashab alayv kak qodem hashshabbat, shekkan en lachush shemma yachazirenna veyitqaenna, kevan sheroshah nishar bassapsal:

Lebenim shennisharu mehabbinyan — muttar letaltelam, lepi shemmeatta enan omedin lebinyan ella lehissamek velashebet alehem, velaken torat keli alehem. Veim sidderam zeh al zeh — gilla dato shehiqtzam lebinyan, veasur letaltelam, sheen torat keli alehem:

Qotz hammunnach birshut harabbim — muttar letaltelo pachot pachot mid' ammot ad sheyyesalleqennu letzidde reshut harabbim, ubekarmelit metaltelo kedarko apillu harbeh baaqira achat, mippene sheyyesh lachush shemma yizzoqu bah rabbim, ubimqom hezzeq rabbim lo gazeru al shebut tiltul d' ammot bekarmelit, o pachot pachot mid' ammot birshut harabbim, vetiltul muqtzeh:

Charayot shel deqel, yesh mehem shemmeyachadim otam lishiba, veyesh mehem sheomedim lisrepa kishar etzim, veim qetzatzam min haddeqel lisrepa — hare hem muqtzeh kishar etzim, veasur letaltelam, sheen torat keli alehem, hoil veomedim lisrepa. Abal im nimlak alehem achar kak sheyyihyu omedim umeyuchadim lishiba ad et sheyyitztarek lepannotam — hare machashaba zo motziam mide machashaba harishona, im nimlak ken qodem hashshabbat, venaasa alehem torat keli, umuttar letaltelam beshabbat lesadderam lesheb alehem, ap al pi shebbeshaa shennimlak alehem bechol lishiba lo haya bedato beperush gam beshabbat, ella nimlak ken al yeshibat hachol. Vaapillu im lo nimlak alehem sheyyihyu omedim umeyuchadim lishiba, ella shechashab alehem mibbeod yom lesheb alehem lemachar beshabbat bilbad, ulemotzae shabbat yishtammesh bahem lisrepa — muttar letaltelam ulesadderam lesheb alehem beshabbat zo:

Vaapillu im lo chashab alehem kelal lishiba, ella sheera miqreh sheyyashab alehem meat qodem hashshabbat — muttar letaltelam beshabbat lesadderam velesheb alehem. Vehu haddin letzorek meqomam, o letzorek atzmam, kedin keli shemmelakto lehetter, lepi shekkevan sheddarkam shel charayot leyachadam gam ken lishiba, lepikak kevan sheyyashab alehem — hukenu lishiba al yede ken, venaasa alehem torat keli:

Abal shear etzim, veken nidbak shel abanim, ap al pi sheyyashab alehem peamim rabbot bechol, vegam chashab alehem sheyyihyu omedim lishiba gam beshabbatot ad et sheyyitztarek lepannotam mikkan — lo yarad alehem torat keli al yede kak, lepi sheen darkam shel shear etzim vaabanim leyachadam lishiba, mippene sheen noach lesheb alehem kemo al hacharayot, lepikak lo hukenu lekak al yede yeshiba o al yede machashaba bilbad, kol shello yichadam lekak leolam. Ella im ken asa bahem maaseh rab lahakinam lishiba, dehaynu shessidderam mibbeod yom kede sheyyihyu mukanim lesheb alehem lemachar, shemmaaseh gadol kazeh moil lehorid alehem torat keli, ap al pi sheen darkam leyached lekak. Abal im shipshepam mibbeod yom kede lesheb alehem lemachar — hare zeh maaseh kol shehu, veeno moil kelum. Vekol zeh eno ella lehattir letaltelam beshabbat lesadderam lesheb alehem, abal lesheb alehem kak beli sheyyigga bahem lesadderam — muttar bekol inyan, ap al pi shello yashab alehem meolam, velo chashab alehem shum machashaba, velo asa bahem shum maaseh mibbeod yom, shekkol muqtzeh eno asur ella betiltul bilbad. Veap im hem mitnaanim tachtayv bishibato — en zeh niqra tiltul, shettiltul kilachar yad hu. Uletaltelam shello letzorek yeshiba ella letzorek meqomam o letzorek acher — asur bekol inyan sheen maaseh hassiddur moil ella letiltul shelletzorek yeshiba, shebbishbil kak sidderum:

Asur letaltel beqaat etz o eben lekassot bahem pi hechabit, o lisgor bahem et haddelet, o lehakkot bahem bebarza listom hanneqeb shebbechabit, ap im kebar nishtammesh bahem tashmish zeh peamim rabbot bechol, vegam chashab alehem mibbeod yom lehishtammesh bahem tashmish zeh beshabbat — en zeh moil kelum, ella im ken yichadam lekak leolam, sheaz yarad alehem torat keli al yede shennityachadu letashmish zeh leolam. Abal mah sheyyichadam letashmish zeh leshabbat zo bilbad — en zeh morid alehem torat keli, ella im ken asa bahem shum maaseh shel tiqqun hammokiach shehem mukanim veomedim lekak, sheaz muttar letaltelam letzorek oto dabar shehukenu lo, abal lo letzorek acher. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bekissuy pi hechabit usegirat haddelet vehakkaa bebarza vekayyotze bidbarim ellu, sheen darkam shel etz veeben leyached otam lekak, abal im chashab alehem lehishtammesh bahem lemachar tashmish sheddarkam leyached otam letashmish zeh, kegon shechashab al haeben liptzoa bah egozim lemachar, ap al pi shello yichadah lekak ella leshabbat zo bilbad — muttar letaltelah gam lekol tzerakayv, lepi shekkevan shehi reuya lehityached lekak leolam vedarkah bekak, lepikak day lah bahakana qalla lahakinah lekak, dehaynu bemachashaba leshabbat zo bilbad, o im nishtammesh bah kebar tashmish zeh mibbeod yom apillu paam achat bilbad — hukena lekak, ap al pi shello chashab aleha leshabbat zo:

Zemora sheyyesh beroshah aqmumiyyut keen mazleg sherauy litlot bah deli ulemallot bah, ap al pi shechashab aleha meereb shabbat lemallot bah beshabbat — asur lemallot bah, ella im ken hayeta qeshura bidli meereb shabbat, gezera shemma tihyeh arukka lo veyiqtemenna mittok shehi rakka venocha liqqatem, venimtza metaqqen keli beshabbat:

Anap shennechtak min hailan mibbeod yom lehanip bo al hashshulchan lehabriach bo hazzebubim — muttar lehanip bo beshabbat uletaltelo kishar kol hakkelim, shekkevan sheyyichado lekak — asao keli gamur. Vehu haddin im yichado leayyem al hattinoqot sheyyakkem bo, vehu sheyyichado lekak mibbeod yom. Abal asur litlosh anap min hammakbedet shemmekabbedim bah habbayit, mippene sheal yede telisha zo metaqqeno lehishtammesh bah mah shehu chapetz lehishtammesh bo, dehaynu hakkaat hattinoqot, vekol dabar shemmetaqqeno lehishtammesh ezeh tashmish — yesh bo issur mishshum tiqqun keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"m. Vaapillu al yede nokri asur letolsho, dehaynu lenatteqo ulehotzio mittachat hakkerak sheal hammakbedet veen tzarik lomar sheasur lishbor anap min hammakbedet, sheyyesh bishbira zo od issur acher mishshum shebirat keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"z. Abal keshemmotzi anap shalem — en bezeh mishshum setirat keli, shehare zeh domeh likli shel peraqim, sheen bipriqatan mishshum soter, ella im ken tequim bechizzuq veumanut, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"g:

Pishtan saruq vetzemer menuppatz shennotenim al hammakka, ap al pi shello chashab alehem sheyyihyu meyuchadim lemakkato, ella hinnicham al makkato derek miqreh qodem hashshabbat vehesiram mimmenna lealtar — muttar letaltelam beshabbat littenam al makkato o letzorek acher, lepi sheddebarim ellu darkam leyachadam lemakka, laken hukenu lekak behannacha bealma, veyarad alehem torat keli. Veen tzarik lomar im chashab alehem mibbeod yom sheyyihyu meyuchadim letittam al hammakka, ap al pi shello netanam adayin meolam al hammakka, o apillu lo chashab alehem sheyyihyu meyuchadim veomedim lemakkato, ella chashab alehem mibbeod yom lehannicham aleha lemachar beshabbat bilbad ulemotzae shabbat yashlikem. Veen tzarik lomar im asa bahem maaseh mibbeod yom lahakinam lekak, kegon shetztzebaam beshemen ukerakan bimshicha. Veen issur behannachatam al gabbe hammakka beshabbat mishshum repua, sheggazeru aleha mishshum shechiqat samemanim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch, lepi shehem enam merappeim, veen mannichim otam ella kede shello yesaretu habbegadim et hammakka:

Veken pishtan saruq vetzemer menuppatz shemmannichim baale haqqorcha berashehem kede sheyyihyu nirim kebaale sear, ap al pi shello chashab alehem sheyyihyu meyuchadim lekak, ella hinnicham al rosho derek miqreh paam achat bechol — muttar letaltelam beshabbat lehannicham berosho o letzorek acher. Veen tzarik lomar im chashab alehem mibbeod yom sheyyihyu meyuchadim lekak, ap al pi shello hinnicham berosho meolam, o apillu lo chashab alehem sheyyihyu meyuchadim veomedim lekak, ella chashab alehem mibbeod yom lehannicham berosho lemachar beshabbat bilbad ulemotzae shabbat yesirem mimmennu veyaaseh lo acherim. Veen tzarik lomar im asa bahem maaseh mibbeod yom lahakinam lekak, kegon shetztzebaan lenoy ukerakan bimshicha. Vekol zeh lehannicham berosho bebeto, abal latzet bahem lirshut harabbim — yesh oserin ella im ken asa bahem maaseh shetztzebaan o shekkerakan. Veim lav — lo yetze bahem, ella im ken hinnicham berosho paam achat mibbeod yom. Abal machashaba veyichud en moilim ella leinyan tiltul velo leinyan hotzaa, lepi shekkevan shello hinnicham berosho mibbeod yom, vegam en bahem maaseh hammokiach shehem metuqqanim lekak — hare zeh nireh kemaarim lehotziam berosho, mah sheen ken bepishtan vetzemer sheal gabbe hammakka — hare makkato mokachat alayv shehu tzarik lahem veeno nireh kemaarim, ap al pi shello hinnicham aleha mibbeod yom:

Orot, ben abudin ben sheenan abodin — muttar letaltelan, mippene sheruyin lehissamek velashebet alehem, veyesh torat keli alehem, ben shehem shel baal habbayit ben shel uman hamabbedan umokeran, sheap hu eno maqpid alehem lehissamek velashebet alehem, veeno choshesh shemma yipchatu demehem al yede kak. Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar letaltel orot sheenan abudin? Keshennityabbeshu kebar, abal keshehem lachim enam reuyim lehissamek velashebet alehem ella middochaq, veen darkam bekak, velaken en alehem torat keli bishbil kak, veasur letaltelam. Veyesh mi shemmattir ap belachin shel behema gassa, veoser shel behema daqqa ap bibeshin, mippene sheenan reuyin lehissamek velashebet alehem mechamat qotnan. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"d vesimman ttz"t:

Nesarim shel baal habbayit — muttar letaltelam. Veshel uman — asur, mippene shehu maqpid alehem millehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish shello yitqalqelu, vahare hem muqtzeh mechamat chesron kis. Veim chashab alehem mibbeod yom litten alehem pat leorechim beshabbat o shum tashmish acher — muttar letaltelam:

Muttar lehaabir meal hashshulchan perurin pechutim mikkezayit, ap sheenan omedim laakilat adam ella libhema o leopot. Veken atzamot sheruyim liklabim, uqelippe perot sheruyot libhema, kegon sharbitim shel qitnit shehaqqitnit gadel betokam, vekol kayyotze bahem — muttar lehaabiran meal hashshulchan, mippene shemmuttarim betiltul kishar maakale behema. Veap al pi shennitparequ haatzamot mehabbasar vehaqqelippot mehapperot beshabbat atzmah, vahare hen nolad kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"a — en bekak kelum, shehannolad muttar beshabbat. Abal beyom tob yesh lehachamir benolad ulehizzaher shello lehaabiran meal hashshulchan, ella kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim en haqqelippot reuyot libhema, kegon qelippe egozim [u]sheqedim vekayyotze bahen shehen asurot betiltul keetzim vaabanim — asur lehaabiran meal hashshulchan ben beyadayv ben bedabar acher shebbeyadayv, kegon legoreran besakkin vekayyotze bo. Velo hittiru tiltul al yede dabar acher, ella kesheddabar haasur kebar hu munnach al dabar hammuttar vehu metaltel beyadayv haddabar hammuttar vehaddabar haasur mittaltel immo meelayv, kegon shemmenaer beyadayv et hattabla o et hammappa shehaqqelippot munnachot aleha kebar vehen ninarot gam ken venopelot mealeha mealehen, shehattabla lo naaset basis ledabar haasur, hoil velo hayu haqqelippot munnachot alayv beben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat, mah sheen ken keshemmegoreran besakkin — enan mittaltelin mealehen, ella hu metaltelen al yede hassakkin shennaaseh lo keyad arukka:

Veasur lehagbiah hattabla o hammappa im haqqelippot shealeha uletaltelah lemaqom acher, ella tzarik lenaaran mimmenna miyyad. Veap al pi sheddabar hammuttar hu shemmetaltel venose beyadayv lemaqom acher vedabar haasur mittaltel alayv meelayv, mikkol maqom lo hittiru letaltel muqtzeh al yede dabar acher tiltul gamur kol sheepshar lenaaro mimmennu miyyad, shehanniur eno tiltul gamur al yede dabar acher, shekkilachar yad hu. Veim yesh pat al hattabla o al hammappa shehaqqelippot aleha — muttar lehagbiah im hakkol uletaltelah lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, mippene shehaqqelippot haellu hen betelot legabbe happat:

Veap im en al hashshulchan ella qelippot ellu o shear debarim sheenam maakal libhema, mikkol maqom im hu beinyan sheen hanniur bilbad moil lo, kegon shehu tzarik lehishtammesh bimqom hashshulchan beinyan sheim yenaaran mimmennu kan veyippelu laaretz kan lo yukal lehishtammesh sham baaretz mah shetztzarik lo — muttar lesalleq hashshulchan lemaqom acher ap al pi shehaddebarim hammuqtzim munnachim alayv, shekkevan shehu lo naasa basis lahem — hare hu metaltel dabar hammuttar vedabar haasur mittaltel immo meelayv:

Chabile qash vachabile etzim rakkim, im hizminam lemaakal behema — muttar letaltelam apillu hem gedolim harbeh. Abal setaman lehassaqa hen omedin, veasur letaltelam. Ubimqomot shessetam qash eno omed lehassaqa ella lemaakal behema o lishkab alayv — muttar letaltelo:

Kol dabar shehu rauy lemaakal min chayya veop hammetzuyim — muttar letaltelo, vaapillu eno rauy lerob mine chayya veop, kegon hachatztzab sheeno rauy ella litzbayim, vehachardal sheeno rauy ella leyonim — muttar letaltelam bemaqom shehatztzebayim vehayyonim metzuyim, dehaynu bemaqom shedderek setam bene adam legaddelam uregilim bekak, velo day bemah shemmetzuyim etzel hassarim bilbad:

Vedabar sheeno rauy ella lechayya veop sheenam metzuyim beotah hair, im yesh lo meoto min chayya o op — muttar letaltel hammaakal harauy lahem, veim lav — asur. Velaken asur letaltel haatzamot bemaqom sheen kelabim metzuyim, kegon im shobet bassadeh o bemalon sheen sham keleb, ben shennitparequ min habbasar beshabbat ben shennitparequ meereb shabbat. Vaatzamot qashim kol kak sheap lakkeleb enan reuyin — asur letaltelan bekol maqom keetzim vaabanim:

Garine temarim bimqomot sheddarkam lehaakilan libhemot — muttar letaltelan. Umikkol maqom, adam chashub tzarik lehachamir al atzmo shello letaltelam ella al derek shinnuy, kegon sheyyanniach etzlam chatikat pat o shear dabar hammuttar betiltul vitaltelem yachad, lepi shebbimqomot harbeh en maakilim otam kelal libhemot, laken yesh lo lehachamir bahem ap bemaqom shemmaakilin:

Kol haqqelippin vehaggarinin sheenan reuyin libhema — okel et haokel vezoreqan bilshono laachorayv, velo yizreqem beyadayv, vegam lo yizreqem bilshono lepanayv veyismok bedato shekkesheyyihyu harbeh mehem lepanayv veyimmaasu beenayv yihyeh muttar lehotzian mishsham kedin garap shel rei sheyyitbaer, lepi sheen osin garap shel rei lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Basar chay, apillu tapel, sheeno maluach kelal — muttar letaltelo, mippene sherauy laakilat adam, sheyyesh bene adam sheddatam yapeh vekosesin basar chay (sheen issur baakilato mishshum dam, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman s"z). Abal basar qasheh sheeno rauy lakos oto — asur letaltelo. Vehu haddin shear debarim kayyotze bo, kegon shuman chay tzonen, sheap sheruyin liklabim — hare enan omedim liklabim ella laakilat adam lemotzae shabbat, ubeshabbat enan reuyin lo liklum. Abal basar tapuach (perush shemmasriach) — muttar letaltelo, mippene sherauy liklabim veomed liklabim:
Dag maluach — muttar letaltelo. Vesheeno maluach — asur, mippene sheeno rauy leshum adam, veeno omed lehashlikan liklabim:
Basar shel nokri shennishchat hayyom — muttar betiltul kemo besar nebela shemmeta beshabbat sheyyitbaer besimman shk"d:

Qamea sheeno mumcheh ap al pi sheen yotzein bo mechashash shemma en moil kelum, veen torat takshit alayv, veim ken en alayv torat keli kelal, shehare eno rauy liklum ap bechol, ben shehu shel ketab ben shehu shel iqqarin — ap al pi ken muttar letaltelo, mippene shello chasheshu lekak ella leinyan issur hotzaa, abal lo leinyan issur tiltul. Veim muttar litloto alayv babbayit ubechatzer — nitbaer besimman sh"g:

Kol dabar metunnap, kegon rei veqi vetzoa, ben shel adam ben shel tarnegolim vekayyotze bahem, im hayu bechatzer shehu dar bah, dehaynu chatzer lipne habbayit o sheetzel habbayit shehu yotze veniknas letokah tadir, shezzehu maqom shemmaqpidin alayv shello yehe bo tinnup — muttar lehotziam laashpa o lebet hakkisse apillu beyadayv mammash belo keli, vezeh hu hanniqra bekol maqom "garap shel rei". Veken im hem bemaboy bimqom derisat haregel — muttar lesalleqam latztzedadin. Abal im hem munnachim bechatzer acheret sheeno dar sham, veken im hem bechatzer sheachore habbayit, shezzehu maqom sheen maqpidim alayv im yesh bo tinnup, ella im ken yoshebim sham, abal kesheen yoshebim sham en maqpidin ap shenniknasim veyotzein sham, hoil veen niknasin veyotzein sham tadir, lepikak asur lehotziam mishsham ella im ken yosheb sham. Veim yare mippene hattinoq shello yelek shamma veyitlaklek bahem — muttar likpot alehem keli, shehakkeli nittal ap bishbil dabar sheeno nittal beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"z. Veap im hem bechatzer sheddar bah, ella shehem becheleq hammuqtzeh mehechatzer laashpa o letarnegolin — asur lehotziam mishsham. Veim garap shel rei omed bemaqom sheen maqpidim alayv keshehu omed kak, ella shehu male vei epshar lippanot alayv sham — muttar lehotzio ulehachaziro bederek sheyyitbaer, mishshum kebod habberiyyot:

Garap shel rei veabit shel me raglayim, ap al pi shemmuttar lehotziam laashpa lepannotam sham — asur lehachaziram labbayit, lepi sheasurim betiltul ap keshehem reqanim, mippene shehem meusim kol kak ad sheenam reuyim apillu lekassot bahem keli, velo hittiru muqtzeh mechamat mius ella im ken rauy lekassot bo keli, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veim tzarik lehachaziram kede lachazor velippanot alehem hayyom — muttar lehachaziram al yede sheyyitten letokam mayim hammuttarim betiltul, dehaynu shehem reuyim adayin libhema ap keshehem betok heabit o haggarap. Veap al pi shello hittiru letaltel dabar haasur betiltul al yede sheyyetaltel immo dabar hammuttar betiltul ella bemet bilbad kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a, mikkol maqom kan shehu tzarik lachazor velippanot alehem hayyom — heqellu mishshum kebod habberiyyot. Vehu haddin im tzarik lachazor ulehotzi bahem tzoa hayyom. Veyesh mattirin lehachaziram labbayit bekol inyan al yede netinat mayim letokam, ap al pi sheeno tzarik lachazor velippanot alehem hayyom velo lehotzi bahem tzoa. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bimqom hepsed, kegon shehaggarap hu chashub qetzat veyesh hepsed im yannichennu baashpa veyigganeb mishsham — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona:

Vekol zeh keshekkebar silleqam miyyado keshehiggia laashpa, abal beodan beyado — muttar lehachaziram ledibre hakkol bekol inyan, veap beli netinat mayim letokam, kedin kol muqtzeh sheim yeshno kebar beyado muttar letaltelo lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ulepi mah shennitbaer sham shettob lehachamir bezeh — gam kan tob litten letokam mayim ap sheodan beyado:

En osin garap shel rei lekattechilla, dehaynu shemmebi lepanayv dabar sheatid limmaes, o sheoseh dabar sheatid limmaes, vesomek bedato sheyyotziennu achar kak kesheyyimmaes, sheap shehittiru lehotzi haddabar hammaus, mikkol maqom lo yaaseh lekattechilla dabar sheyyihyeh bevadday achar kak maus lepanayv veyotziennu. Umikkol maqom, im abar veasa ken — muttar lehotzio achar kak. Veim en bedato bitchilla sheyyotziennu achar kak — muttar laasot ken ap lekattechilla, veachar kak im nimlak lehotzio — hare zeh muttar:

Bimqom hepsed muttar liqboa yeshibato etzel garap shel rei, shehu bemaqom sheen maqpidin alayv kede sheyyimmaes haggarap beenayv veyotziennu mishsham veyistalleq hahepsed, kegon im ezeh dabar nimas venipsad mippene haggeshamim hayyoredim alayv bechatzer sheeno dar sham — yakol lehaknis lesham mittato lishkab aleha, o lehaknis shulchano leekol sham, vehu haddin lishar kele tashmisho, kegon separayv lilmod bahem, vekayyotze beinyan zeh, shezzehu niqra qebiut yeshiba, ukeshettitonen dato alayv mippene hammius yotziennu mishsham lemaqom hamshummar mippene haggeshamim, veken kol kayyotze beinyan zeh. Abal yeshiba bilbaddah belo mitta o shulchan o shear kele tashmisho — enah moelet kelum, mippene sheim titonen dato alayv mippene hammius — anu omerim lo qum velek mikkan vesheb bemaqom acher, kevan shemmittechilla lo haya yosheb kan veakshav niknas derek aray, mah sheen ken kesheqqaba kan dirato al yede mitta o shulchan o shear kele tashmisho — en matrichim oto laaqor dirato mikkan, ella motziin et haggarap millepanayv:

Maknis adam melo quppato apar mibbeod yom umeareh oto bebeto laaretz, umuttar laasot bo kol tzerakayv beshabbat, kegon littol mimmennu lekassot roq o tzoa vekayyotze bazeh. Vehu sheyyiched lo qeren zavit, sheaz nikkar haddabar shehu mukan veomed lekak. Abal im era oto beemtza beto lemidras raglayim — hare hu batel legabbe apar qarqa habbayit umuqtzeh hu, veasur letaltelo. Lepikak, perot hattemunim bechol — muttar littelam mishsham beshabbat, sheen oto heapar muqtzeh, shehare hekino lekak mittechilla veyiched lo keli o qeren zavit. Ubilbad sheyyehe heapar tichuach kol kak beinyan sheen bo mishshum asiyyat guma, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"ch:

Asur letaltel behema o chayya o op, mippene sheenan reuyim beshabbat keshehem chayyim. Vaapillu op sherauy letzacheq bo tinoq keshebbokeh — asur letaltelo. Veap al pi ken muttar likpot et hassal lipne haeprochim kede sheyyaalu veyeredu bo, shehakkeli nittal ap letzorek dabar sheeno nittal beshabbat. Veap al pi shebbeod shehaeprochim al hassal asur letaltel et hassal mippene haeprochim shealayv — ap al pi ken en kan bittul keli mehekano apillu lepi shaa, hoil ubeyado lehapriach haeprochim mehassal miyyad shealu o sheyyaredu alayv, o shello yaamdu alayv apillu rega uleachar sheyyaredu mealayv — muttar letaltelo. Veim hayu haeprochim al hassal kol meshek ben hashshemashot — asur letaltelo kol hayyom kullo ap leachar sheyyaredu, shemmittok shehuqtza venaasa basis leissur beben hashshemashot — huqtza lekol hayyom kullo:

Kol behema chayya veop medaddin otam birshut hayyachid, dehaynu sheochez betzavvaran ubitzdadin umesayyean, umenaanea raglehen sheyyeleku, ubilbad shello yagbihem beinyan sheyyeaqeru raglehem min haaretz, shemmuqtzim hem vaasurim betiltul. Veap al pi shekkol muqtzeh keshem sheasur letaltel kullo kak asur letaltel miqtzato — ap al pi ken hittiru lo ledaddot otam mishshum tzaar baale chayyim, im habbaale chayyim tzerikim lekak, abal im enam tzerikim lekak — asur apillu ledaddot otam. Vetarnegolet asur apillu ledaddot otah apillu hi tzerika lekak, mippene shehi magbahat atzmah keshemmedaddim otah, venimtza zeh metaltel et kullah, vezeh lo hittiru mishshum tzaar baale chayyim. Abal muttar lidchot otah meachoreha beyadayim kede shettikkanes lallul im borcha mimmennu:

Vekol zeh ledaddot birshut hayyachid, abal birshut harabbim asur ledaddot shum behema chayya veop, gezera shemma yagbihem veyolikem, veyitchayyeb mishshum maabir d' ammot birshut harabbim. Velo ameru "hachay nose et atzmo" ella beadam, abal lo bibhema chayya veop. Vekarmelit dino kirshut harabbim leinyan zeh. Velidchot otam meacharehem im barechu — muttar apillu birshut harabbim:

Haishsha medadda et benah apillu birshut harabbim, sheen ligzor shemma tagbihennu vetolikennu arba ammot birshut harabbim, sheap im taaseh ken — lo taabor al dabar shel tora, ella al dabar shel dibre soperim, shehachay nose et atzmo. Ubilbad shello tegarerehu, ella yehe magbiah raglo haachat veyanniach hashsheniyya al haaretz, veyishshaen aleha ad sheyyachazor veyanniach raglo shehigbiah, shennimtza leolam hu nishan al raglo haachat. Abal keshehi goreret shette raglayv — hare zeh kenoseato, veasur apillu bekarmelit. Veim hu qatan kol kak shetztzarik ligror b' raglayv unesaattu birshut harabbim — chayyebet, shebbeqatan kazeh en omerim hachay nose et atzmo. Veken hannose et hakkaput o et hacholeh sheeno yakol lelek kelal — chayyab, mippene sheenan nosein et atzman kelal. Veap im hu gadol kol kak sheyyakol lelek beraglayv lebaddo — asur lissa oto apillu bekarmelit, shello ameru hachay nose et atzmo ella liptor mechattat, abal al kol panim asur middibre soperim mishshum shebut, ubekarmelit hu shebut dishbut. Vetzarik lehazhir lerabbim shettoim bazeh:

Keli shennitroea — lo yitlosh mimmenna cheres lekassot bo o lismok bo, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli, shekkol dabar shemmetaqqeno beshabbat lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish — yesh bo mishshum tiqqun keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"m:

Asur lischoq bekaddur beshabbat veyom tob, lepi sheasur letaltelo mippene sheen torat keli alayv. Veyesh mattirim letaltelo velischoq bo birshut ha[yachid]. Venahagu miqqedem lehaqel velo michu beyadam, hoil veyesh lahem al mi sheyyismoku:
Asur laset tachat atztzilayv zera hattolaim sheosim hammeshi, mippene sheasur betiltul, shehare eno rauy liklum, veod shemmolid bechummo:

Yesh oserim letaltel beged shaatnez shel yisrael apillu letzorek gupo umeqomo, mippene sheeno rauy liklum, lo lehitlabbesh bo, velo lehatztzio tachtayv im eno beged qasheh, al derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea simman sh"a. Veyesh mattirim letzorek gupo o meqomo, mippene shemmikkol maqom yesh torat keli alayv, ella shemmelakto leissur. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona, mippene sheen torat keli moil ella likli shemmelakto leissur beshabbat bilbad abal bechol melakto lehetter, sheap im beshabbat eno rauy kelal leshum tashmish — muttar letaltelo, hoil veyesh alayv torat keli, dehaynu sherauy hu limlakto bechol, kegon ner shemmadliqin bo nept, shebbeshabbat eno rauy liklum, umuttar letaltelo mippene sheyyesh alayv torat keli, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im gam bechol eno rauy limlaka, kegon beged shaatnez sheasur lehitlabbesh bo gam bechol — en alayv torat keli umalbush kelal, sheap sherauy lehishtammesh bo tashmish acher, kegon lekassot bo kelim, o lehaahil bo lemala merosho, vekayyotze betashmishim ellu, sheen habbeged meyuchad lahem velo naasa bishbil kak — enan moridin alayv torat keli, ella im ken yichado lekak, kemo shekkol tzerorot vaabanim shehem reuyim lekissuy kelim, veap al pi ken en alehem torat keli al yede kak ella im ken yichadam lekak, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veen moil kelal lehabbeged mah sheyyesh alayv tzurat vetoar malbush, kevan sheasur lelobsho, kemo sheen moil lemaakal haasur baakila beshabbat lehattiro betiltul mippene sheyyesh alayv toar okel, vetorat okel adip mittorat keli:
Muttar letaltel menipa kede lehabriach bah hazzebubim, mippene shekkeli hu. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yaharog zebub:

Makbedot shemmekabbedin bahen haqqarqa — hare hen kikli shemmelakto lehetter ledibre hammattirin lekabbed bahen beshabbat qarqa hamrutztzap, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"z. Veap shemmekabbedin bahen gam ken qarqa sheeno merutztzap bechol, mikkol maqom hare hen kikli shemmelakto leissur ulehetter shemmuttar letaltelo kikli shemmelakto lehetter, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal ledibre haoserim lekabbed beshabbat ap qarqa hamrutztzap — asur letaltelan ki im letzorek gupan o meqoman, kikli shemmelakto leissur. Keli shechozim bo hakkokabim im muttar lehappeko uletaltelo lehabbit bo — nitbaer besimman sh"z:

Mah shemmoreh al hashshaot, ben shehu shel chol ben shel min acher, kegon sheroin betzel — nitpashshet hamminhag leosro betiltul ki im letzorek gupo, dehaynu shetztzarik lehishtammesh begupo ezeh tashmish hammuttar, o letzorek meqomo kikli shemmelakto leissur, lepi shennaasa limdidat hazzeman o hatztzel, veyesh ledammotah limdida haasura beshabbat. Veen lehattirah mippene shehi medida shel mitzva, shehu lomed al yede keli zeh, shello hittiru medida shel mitzva ella keshehammedida beatzmah yesh bah mitzva, kegon limdod hammiqveh vekayyotze bah, abal kan hammedida beatzmah en bah shum inyan mitzva, vei mishshum shellomed al yadah — ek yitleh limmudo bedabar haasur veyihyeh muttar al yede kak? Zehu taam hamminhag, abal min haddin en issur barur baddabar velo hetter barur:

Apillu dabar harauy beshabbat, im hu garua beene haashirim veen darkam lehishtammesh bo mechamat oshram — naasa dabar zeh muqtzeh gamur lahem, veneesar lahem betiltul, ap shehu shel aniyyim, ella haashirim shebbebet haaniyyim muttarim letaltelo kemo haaniyyim atzmam. Veim dabar zeh hu shel ashir — asur betiltul ap lekol haaniyyim shebbaolam, shemmittok shehuqtza libalayv — huqtza lekol haolam. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bedabar sheeno rauy libalayv mechamat geriuto beene bealayv, abal dabar sheeno rauy libalayv mechamat shehu asur lahem, kegon yayin lenazir — lo naasa muqtzeh bishbil kak, hoil vehu muttar laacherim, ulepikak ap hannazir atzmo muttar letaltelo:
